8mze:
UEL's business management course is designed to equip students with adaptable skills for navigating the ever-changing business landscape. Through hands-on training and real-world projects, students will gain practical experience and insights into innovative business approaches, preparing them for business graduate jobs.

What are the benefits of studying a business management course with UEL? Students will:

  • develop the qualities, skills, and techniques needed to handle complexity and drive outstanding performance both at university and in the workplace.
  • understand and communicate cutting-edge developments, strategies, and leadership approaches that are crucial for businesses trying to ensure a sustainable future.
  • gain skills in project management methodologies to steer projects from start to finish.
  • enhance supply chain efficiency with thorough analysis and strategic planning to boost performance.
  • do work-oriented projects, and internships, including an optional year-long industry placement. This will enrich educational experience with significant exposure to the real world, preparing students for graduate jobs in the business sector.
8n91:
This MSc in Artificial Intelligence is for anyone building a career in Artificial Intelligence (specialising in machine learning and deep learning). Students will learn to create intelligent software and algorithms that support better business decisions and help shape strategy in any organisation.

This artificial intelligence (AI) programme gives students advanced knowledge and skills to help design and build machine learning tools for automation, prediction, and smart decision-making.

As an Artificial Intelligence postgraduate, students will learn through a mix of lectures, hands-on workshops using tools like Python, Hadoop, Spark, and Matlab, and lab-based sessions. They will also take part in practical projects, seminars, and work-based learning to build both technical and professional skills.
8na7:
UEL's MSc in International Business Management prepares students for a huge variety of business roles in a global context, whether they are interested in entrepreneurship, global innovation, corporate strategy, consultancy, or multinational management. UEL's staff and students are drawn from all over the world with widely varied expertise, making this MSc a truly international programme.

The course looks toward future trends in business, from the changing role of business in society to the impact that rapidly evolving technology has on business in a global context. The university trains students to be mobile across different markets in high-tech, knowledge-intensive industries; remain flexible in the face of technological change, and maintain an international outlook as the world evolves.

Students will learn about the way businesses can adapt to new challenges, from the importance of sustainability in the face of climate change to the rise of robotics and the Internet of Things.

Based across Docklands and USS campuses, students will have easy access to London City Airport, City Of London Square Mile, Canary Wharf financial and digital district, International Excel Centre and the O2 Arena.

The course is designed to resonate with people from a variety of backgrounds, so students won't need to have specific academic or work experience. Throughout the degree, students will develop crucial analytical, research, and communication skills as they work on projects with their fellow students and undertake their own original research. UEL's personal tutoring scheme also gives students access to bespoke academic advice and exciting industry opportunities.

This course is accredited by the Association for Project Management (APM).

8naq:
The MSc Public Health degree will develop students' management competencies and research techniques, equipping them to develop their career as a health professional..

The skills students will develop on this course will put them in a good position to progress in their career and take on leadership roles. The course will focus on hot topics within health and cover core modules on epidemiology, health promotion, and global health. UEL's health students often organise local health campaigns within the community, so there are plenty of opportunities to get involved and make a difference.

Whatever sector the candidates are working in - the NHS, private health or social care services, community health organisations, or a related commercial sector - students will benefit from studying in a superbly resourced environment that is producing research internationally recognised as being of the highest quality.
8nwn:
Throughout this two-semester Pre-Master’s programme, students will strengthen their English language skills by learning specialist academic language related to their subject area. Students will also develop a broad range of essential academic and professional skills, including:

  • Business Language
  • Academic Writing
  • Critical Thinking
  • Academic Research
  • Presentation Skills
  • Poster Presentations

UEL's supportive and experienced teachers will guide students every step of the way, helping them reach their full potential. Students will learn through a variety of dynamic and engaging methods. These include discussions, presentations, lectures, small group tutorials, and personal tutor sessions. Each activity is designed to build students' confidence and prepare them for postgraduate study.

The University of East London understands that academic success alone is not enough in today’s evolving business environment. To become an effective leader, students also need strong emotional intelligence, decision-making skills, resilience, and adaptability. These vital competencies are a key focus of the Mental Wealth module, which is integrated into this programme.

Upon successful completion of the Pre-Master’s programme, students may progress to one of the following degrees:

  • MSc Finance and Risk
  • MSc Human Resource Management
  • MSc International Business Management
  • MBA
  • MBA (Digital Marketing)
  • MBA (Fintech Management)
  • MBA (Project Management)
  • MBA (Business Analytics)
  • MBA (Supply Chain Management)
  • MBA with Placement Year
  • MSc Oil and Gas Management
  • MSc Professional Accounting
  • LLM Business and Financial Law
  • LLM Energy and Natural Resources Law
  • LLM General
  • LLM Human Rights Advocacy
  • LLM International Law and Legal Practice
  • LLM Transitional Justice and Conflict
  • MSc Sports Management
  • MA Conflict, Displacement and Human Security
  • MSc International Relations
  • MSc NGO and Development Management
  • MA Refugee Studies
8n4s:
This MBA is open to the world and challenges students to become the best they can be. It is based in the vibrancy of East London and led by expert academics to offer an accessible, flexible and stimulating springboard into a chosen career. Students' journey to becoming a Master in Business Administration will include simulations, experiential and practice-based learning, exposure to experts from industry and politics as well as opportunities to build personal capital and global network for continuous professional growth.

The course prepares students for a changing world by developing talents in enterprise, decision making, critical thinking and responsible leadership. Students will learn to operate strategically, collaboratively and sustainably, deploying emerging digital technologies to exploit opportunities and solve society’s problems.

UEL is rooted in London's most exciting region for enterprise, between the major financial institutions of Canary Wharf and pioneering new businesses in Stratford and Shoreditch. UEL works with these institutions, from Bloomberg to Barclaycard, to bring students cutting-edge insight into the way contemporary businesses are run.

This MBA is geared towards students' career development, ensuring they graduate with a clearer vision of the future. So, whether students want to work in senior management, business consultancy, or build their own enterprise, this MBA will give students the skills, inspiration, and connections to achieve it.
8n4d:
This MBA (Business Analytics) is a dynamic, contemporary, and practical course designed to produce data-driven business leaders of the future. The Industry 4.0 revolution is creating a transformational and competitive business scenario that is full of challenges that demand effective solutions.

As a professional in the business industry, MBA graduates ought to be aware of the crucial role that business analytics - the strategic analysis of data to make the best decisions - play, with regard optimising processes and creating competitive advantages. This pathway will help students develop competencies and abilities in the field of Data Science (DS) applicable to the business industry. Learn how to analyse data to derive Business Intelligence (BI) and use Business Analytics (BA) to drive effective decisions and successful future outcomes.

Everything in this MBA is geared towards students' career development, ensuring students graduate with a clearer vision of their future; it's accredited by the Chartered Management Institute, so students can be sure they are learning the leadership skills that employers really need, and UEL's expert staff has the depth of knowledge to turn students' passion and ambition into a realisable goal.

The Digital Marketing MBA is a digital marketing analytics pathway through this dynamic and contemporary MBA degree - designed to produce marketing business leaders of the future. The rapidly changing business contexts, technological advancements, and social transformations mean marketing practices now rely heavily upon the analysis and interpretation of digital data.

This pathway seeks to develop the numerical and analytical skills needed to be able to decipher data sets that are of relevance to marketers. It develops a specific focus on two key areas in its design - big data and customer relationship management. This enables marketers to make sense of data and aid marketing decision-making. The programme will greatly benefit those with strong numerical skills and an aptitude for qualitative and quantitative data analysis relevant to business decision-making.

Everything in this MBA is geared towards students' career development, ensuring they graduate with a clearer vision of their future. UEL's expert staff has the depth of knowledge to turn students' passion and ambition into a realisable goal.
